class.name: NNBTScoreBasedPicker
class.brief_description: Scores its child branches with considerations and runs the highest-scoring one.
class.description: Brings utility AI scoring into a behaviour tree. Add [NNConsiderations] nodes as direct children of each candidate branch under this node; at the start of each run, the picker evaluates every enabled branch's score, selects the highest-scoring one (breaking ties by child order), and runs it until it finishes.
